description: Create a Draft Bulk-Supply farm shipment (Sell Parts) for this farm. Enforces campaign.minQuantity (e.g. 20 pairs for wings) and monthlyLimit. Opens a support ticket. Set confirm:true to commit. Next step: update_supplier_shipment_tracking when shipped.

confirm.description: Set true to persist; otherwise dry-run preview

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key to prevent duplicate shipment

paymentDetails.description: Payment destination details (stored on shipment; never logged)

quantity.description: Units to reserve; must be >= campaign.minQuantity

name: create_supplier_shipment
